title: Chunk
description:
The retrieval-index seam contract: one chunk as emitted by the Python parse service (scripts/emit_chunks.py, as ChunkRecord.model_dump(mode='json')) across the JSON boundary to the backend, which validates against this SAME file and ingests it into the `chunks` table. This validates ONE chunk; the backend walks payload['chunks']. A change here must be made on both repos' contracts/ together, or the contract job fails -- the same discipline claims.schema.json carries.

A chunk is element-based and PAGE-BOUNDED: it never spans two pages, so every span resolves back to an exact source location in that page's text. Retrieval metadata (document_id, scale_context, element_type) is stamped at creation and immutable.

content.description: The chunk's text as retrieved and embedded.

element_type.description: What the chunk is cut from; the three retrieve differently.

page.description: 1-based source page. A chunk never spans two pages.

order.description: Document-order sort key, stable across a run.

document_id.description: Source document sha256; the backend maps it to a data_source id.

scale_context.description: The page/column scale banner in force for numbers in this chunk (e.g. 'CAD in Thousands'), or null.

spans.description: (char_start, char_end) pairs into the page's text, one per source block, so page.text[start:end] round-trips the block.

bbox.description: Region citation for a chart/table chunk gathered by geometry, not reading order; null for prose.

section.description: The section heading governing this chunk, or null.
